title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | K-IG 교육 ENGLISH | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육- 113 ]

blocks.text: There are many religions in Korea. My family and I are Christians.
We go to church every Sunday. I also have many friends at church.
Buddhists usually just go on special days of the year to the temple.
Others go on trips with their families to the countryside, seaside,
On Sundays, some people either like to go shopping with friends
or spend their time watching TV or playing computer games.
Sometimes if I have a test coming up the following week,
I have to study all weekend long.
